title: From Delegation to Coordination: Learning Efficient Multi-Agent Deep Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.17041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent deep-research systems use delegation to parallelize search and keep long tool traces out of the main agent's context. Yet delegation helps only when task allocation and subtask execution are coordinated: the main agent must issue useful subtasks, while subagents must return reliable evidence. Existing training either optimizes only the main agent or broadcasts the same team advantage to all agents, which can reward misleading subagent reports and penalize useful ones. We introduce LEAD-RL (Learning Effective Agent Delegation with Reinforcement Learning), a joint main-agent-subagent training framework with contribution-aware credit assignment. A training-time rubric evaluates the research utility of each subagent report and gates its inherited team advantage, while final-answer correctness remains the only team reward; no token, step, or speedup reward is used. translated_title: 从委派到协调：学习高效的多智能体深度研究
translated_abstract: 多智能体深度研究系统通过委派机制来并行化搜索，并将冗长的工具调用轨迹隔离在主智能体的上下文之外。然而，只有当任务分配与子任务执行相互协调时，委派才能发挥作用：主智能体必须发出有用的子任务，而子智能体必须返回可靠的证据。现有的训练方法要么只优化主智能体，要么将相同的团队优势广播给所有智能体，这可能会奖励误导性的子智能体报告，却惩罚有用的报告。我们提出了LEAD-RL（基于强化学习的高效智能体委派学习），一个具有贡献感知信用分配的主智能体与子智能体联合训练框架。训练时的评估准则会衡量每个子智能体报告的研究效用，并据此控制其继承的团队优势，而最终答案的正确性仍然是唯一的团队奖励；不使用任何基于token、步骤或加速的奖励。在五个基准测试和两个模型系列上，LEAD-RL提升了……
tldr: 提出LEAD-RL框架，通过贡献感知的信用分配实现主智能体与子智能体的联合强化学习训练，显著提升多智能体深度研究系统中委派协作的有效性。
en_tdlr: LEAD-RL, a joint main-agent-subagent reinforcement learning framework with contribution-aware credit assignment, improves the efficiency of multi-agent deep research systems.
